name: Demonic Suitors
source:
You have just received an invitation to a prestigious school and are on your way when your chauffeur takes a sudden turn into a dark tunnel! You’re certain this must be a mistake but after the bumpy ride, you’re greeted by a devilishly handsome young man who calls you “princess.” Just one thing, though—he’s got horns on his head! If there’s one thing the school failed to inform you, it’s that the school is for demons.

Why are you being called “Princess,” and why do all these dashing demons suddenly want your hand in marriage?! Perhaps it’s the fact that you’re actually the half-demon daughter of Satan, and he’s brought you here to further your education so you can rule Hell one day… And get you a man!

All of your suitors are the best of the best in Anathema Academy, but how could you possibly choose when they’re all determined to win your hand in marriage?!

Surrender to your desires in Demonic Suitors!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.demonacademy]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚收到一所名校的邀请，正在上路的时候，你的司机突然拐进了一条黑暗的隧道！你确信这一定是一个错误，但在颠簸的旅程之后，迎接你的是一位英俊的年轻人，他称你为“公主”。但只有一件事——他头上有角！如果学校没有告诉你一件事，那就是这所学校是为恶魔而设的。

为什么你被称为“公主”，为什么所有这些潇洒的恶魔突然想要与你结婚？！也许事实上，你实际上是撒旦的半恶魔女儿，他把你带到这里来继续你的教育，这样你有一天就可以统治地狱……并给你一个男人！

你所有的追求者都是诅咒学院里最优秀的人，但当他们都决心要赢得你的婚姻时，你怎么可能选择呢？

在恶魔追求者中屈服于你的欲望！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.demonacademy]Google Play[/url]]
